description: Mints an anonymous draft identity (a draft token) with no account and no sign-in. You usually do NOT need to call this first: create_site_from_brief and create_site_from_html mint one for you and return it. Use this only when you want the token before composing anything. You can edit or claim this draft for 7 days from creation.

name.description: Optional display name for the draft site.

name: draft_create
title: Create anonymous draft site
